title: Verify v1 acceptance criteria
lead: Run each v1 acceptance criterion (C15-C19) end to end as Go tests plus the two manual viewer checks, and record the result.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** new features; fixes, which become their own slices.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: PROJECT.md defines v1 by five acceptance criteria. This slice is the gate.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/acceptance/acceptance_test.go` (new, test-only package): one test per automatable criterion, driving `cmd/pit`'s `run` function or the packages, with files under `t.TempDir()`.
- `internal/acceptance/testdata/`: golden imp vs dwarf seed 1 result text and replay hash (the hash equals S11's pinned value).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestC15SpecCoverage`: reuses the S06 spec-table parser; every opcode, modifier and mode in `docs/spec/isa.md` has a test case.
- `TestC16ImpDwarfSeed1`: `pit run bots/imp.s bots/dwarf.s --seed 1` result and replay hash equal the golden files, on two runs.
- `TestC17Assembler`: the malformed-input cases report line and column; every starter bot and spec example round-trips.
- `TestC18Tournament`: the starter-bot tournament over 100 rounds runs twice with identical scoreboards (guarded by `testing.Short()` if slow).
- C19 is checked manually (see Check) unless the owner has approved Node for S15's tests, in which case the web side runs with `node --test`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- C15: compare the spec's opcode, modifier and mode tables against the test enumeration.
- C16: run imp vs dwarf at seed 1 and compare result and replay hash to the golden files.
- C17: run the malformed-input and round-trip suites.
- C18: run the 100-seed starter-bot tournament twice and compare.
- C19: the terminal viewer's `TestFrames` and the web viewer's `model.test.js` both check `testdata/viewer/frames.json`; also play `internal/replay/testdata/imp_dwarf_seed1.jsonl` in both viewers by hand.
- C16 says "every run and machine". CI is deferred (C33), so record in the note which machines (OS, arch, Go version) ran the suite; one machine is a recorded limitation, not a pass on "every machine".

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes, including `internal/acceptance` without `-short`.
- `web/test.html` passes in a browser (or `node --test` if approved).
- A note on this item lists each criterion with its command and outcome, and the machines used.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-acceptance` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
